run.userPrompt:
In 2026, four-day-week pilots and 'right to disconnect' laws have spread unevenly across countries. A global software company faces pressure from younger employees in some markets demanding compressed weeks, while teams in other markets view reduced office presence as career-damaging or disloyal. Local labor laws, client expectations, and cultural attitudes toward visible effort differ across its twelve country offices.

Design a global flexible-work policy that accommodates divergent cultural attitudes toward working time, visibility, and commitment, while remaining fair, legal, and operationally workable across twelve countries.
